name: box
description: the owner's dev box as it stands: ReShade 6.8 proxy + RenoDX DLSS addon + NVIDIA DLSSNR + the installed mod

report.verdict: the baseline every other profile is a diff against

payloads.note: RenoDX DLSS addon; ReShade loads it from DllMain
older RenoDX addon; the .addon64x extension is not scanned, so it is inert
NVIDIA DLSSNR runtime 310.8.0.0, 165 MB, same install batch as the proxy
AddonPath=. and LoadFromDllMain=renodx-dlss.addon64 are what make the addon load; ReShade rewrites this file while it runs
leftover second config, read by nothing; declared because it is on the box
OptiScaler goes here; it must not be present in this configuration
and its nine libraries live in this folder. Stated as a tree so the guarantee is 'no OptiScaler here' rather than 'none of the nine files someone remembered to list'

expect.note: modules are matched on the END of the loaded module's full path, because Windows loads its own dxgi.dll and dwmapi.dll from System32 into every process and a name alone would match those

manual.driver_vsync: the owner's word — not readable from a script
manual.monitors: three: 1920x1080 @ 75 Hz primary, 1920x1080 @ 100 Hz, 1080x1920 @ 75 Hz rotated; the game runs on the primary
